$description: Every published Block and the REAL source file behind each platform it claims. Platform names are validated against components.manifest.json -> platformDefinitions; this file deliberately does not redeclare them, so there is still exactly one authoritative platform-definition site. Coverage is explicit: a platform absent from a block's `sources` is not supported, and nothing is ever inferred. Source paths are written out rather than guessed from the slug, because a block's file naming differs per platform and a wrong guess would silently drop a real implementation. scripts/check-block-source.mjs verifies every path exists and carries the extraction markers; scripts/gen-block-examples.mjs turns them into the snippets the website shows.
$blockCatalogue: Unlike the component catalogue, the Block catalogue is NOT expected to exist on every platform: a block is an example of composition, not part of the library's surface. A platform with no source for a block is simply not offered for it — that is not an exception needing a documented reason, and no `catalogComplete` model applies here.
